------------------------------------------------------------------------
Suppose you asked leftists to make a list of ALL the things that were
wrong with society, and then suppose you instituted EVERY social change
that they demanded. It is safe to say that within a couple of years the
majority of leftists would find something new to complain about, some
new social "evil" to correct because, once again, the leftist is
motivated less by distress at society's ills than by the need to satisfy
his drive for power by imposing his solutions on society.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The Unabomber Manifesto; Paragraph 220
